messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up: incoming pen test next week. Need to coordinate RBAC patch, KMS credential rotation, and audit export for the retest. Can we run a short ops plan?
Maria Ortiz: Yep. Which services are in-scope? and any showstopper regressions we must avoid?
Samir Patel: In-scope: inference-gateway, admin API, kms-proxy. Immediate risk: /admin/api accepts wildcard role bindings (HIGH). KMS proxy keys overdue for rotation (MED). Inference-gateway had verbose debug off — we'll enable short-term audit streaming.
Jordan Lee: I sketched a runbook: (A) deploy RBAC change to staging canary (5% traffic) for 1h, (B) run canary smoke tests, (C) rotate kms-proxy creds during a 2h maintenance window with pre/post audit snapshots, (D) hand evidence to assessor readroom.
Alex Chen: Ops window preferred Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Maria, can you prepare the RBAC PR and tests? Samir, can you prepare the audit queries and S3 export? Jordan will own scheduling.
Maria Ortiz: I'll open PR now. Tests: - reduced role cannot access /admin/api, - canary users unaffected, - rate limits intact. I'll add a test that asserts token scope headers present. PR ETA: EOD today.
Samir Patel: Audit query for KMS access (will run pre/post):
```
SELECT timestamp, actor, action, resource, success
FROM audit_events
WHERE resource = 'kms:inference-proxy'
  AND action IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey','Encrypt')
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '{{pre_start}}' AND '{{pre_end}}'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500
```
Samir Patel: Uploading pre-rotation logs to readroom now. Will attach presigned link in the tracker.
Jordan Lee: ops-bot, please reserve Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC and notify oncall. Also add an observability gate: if KMS access rate > 3x baseline in 30m, abort rotation.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Notifying oncall and posting to #release-war-room.
Alex Chen: Good. Ownership summary: Maria = RBAC PR + smoke tests, Samir = audit exports + evidence packaging, Jordan = maintenance window + rollback gate, Alex = assessor liaison and retest scheduling.
Maria Ortiz: One ask: can we do a dry-run of the RBAC reduction in staging earlier today (no creds rotated) so the team can validate smoke tests?
Jordan Lee: Yes — I'll flip canary routing to 5% in staging at 18:00 UTC and monitor for 45m. If green, proceed with production window.
Samir Patel: Note: when rotating kms-proxy keys, ensure service-account token TTLs are refreshed. I'll add a checklist item: rotate key -> restart proxy -> validate decrypts -> revert TTLs if fail.
Alex Chen: Thanks. After rotation, we'll snapshot audit exports and upload to readroom for assessor. Maria, ping assessor with timeline once PR posted.
Maria Ortiz: Will do. Tagging: @Samir Patel @Jordan Lee :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Meeting adjourned — reconvene once PR is merged or if any blocker pops up.
